compatibility_sentinels.description: Zero legacy write fields are unavailable-data sentinels. Full hardware write accounting must reject this nominal-only profile.

limitations: 256 bins discretize a continuous compact model; reliable physical 8-bit storage is not demonstrated
readback evaluates frozen native state, with no read-disturb transient
device/cycle variation, read noise and retention are not calibrated; nominal variation is zero
MNSIM uses equivalent conductance at 0.1 V; full nonlinear I-V is not executed at runtime
nominal ideal stop-at-target programming; not a calibrated discrete-pulse/verify controller
2 V cell programming amplitude is an experiment assumption; source-default model parameters are unchanged
ambient temperature is assumed at each transaction start; inter-transaction thermal memory is not retained
write-cell integral excludes unmodeled verify/forming costs; MNSIM separately adds its configured peripherals
